title: Deadalus
overview:
The government central control fortress "Daedalus"
A clash between old truth and new truth

The map changes every time you try!?
Thrilling battles unfold from a 3D viewpoint

Deadalus is a first-person shooter set aboard Daedalus, the orbiting station from which a centuries-old regime rules Earth. As a rebel pilot in an assault robot, you fight your way up through the fortress floor by floor, aiming to destroy the core at its top.

Every floor is generated anew. Find the key card that unlocks the elevator to the next level, flip light switches to brighten darkened halls, and use the on-screen map to find your way while enemy robots close in. Hang around too long and suicide attackers come after you.

- Arm punch, vulcan, laser and missile launcher, each upgradeable
- Generator-powered abilities such as hovering, a shield barrier and a screen-clearing laser
- Monitor your shield level as you go

政府中央管理要塞「ダイダロス」
古き真理と、新たな真理の激突

トライするたびにマップが変化!?
3D視点で繰り広げられる興奮のバトル
